scope: Matched pilot geometry/curvature sensitivity. Not a historical-release comparison, experimental accuracy test or production-state replacement.
model_basis: One geometry per state. Both arms scored with the same accuracy0.001/extreme-grid matched xTB solvent increment. Gas arm retains gas electronic curvature; aqueous arm uses combined effective-potential curvature.
standard_state_note: Solute standard-state and common elemental/charge offsets cancel in this difference. Individual raw quantities omit later biochemical transformations.
